purpose: Separate successor contract requirements that can be frozen independently of the Plant representation from those that must wait for RES-83 (human-valid Plant rebuild), RES-84 (measurement rebuild), or RES-87 (recovery envelope calibration).

PLANT_INDEPENDENT_FROZEN_NOW.REQUIREMENT: Task identity: nominal bilateral 20 kg loaded countermovement jump
Context of use and claim ceiling
Jump-height definition families and the primary canonical quantity (direct COM rise physical-takeoff to apex)
Physical takeoff semantics (contact geometry + clearance + upward COM velocity), independent of force thresholds
Apex semantics (zero crossing inside physical flight, no dwell)
Event DAG E1-E12 order, predecessors, dwell types/convention, blockers, negative controls
Countermovement concept: supported negative COM motion, depth, reversal, sustained propulsion
Landing capture concept: whole-body state, momentum capture not vertical-arrest alone
Balance capture variables (sagittal COM speed, Hy, support margin, CoP validity, bilateral support)
Recovery/standing envelope structure and robustness-calibration obligation (RES-87)
Support continuity scope IDs and full-episode requirement
E12 is a physical-state event; controller handoff reported separately
Canonical metric retention list and metric classes
Negative control designs NC-01..NC-10 and expected verdicts

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REQUIREMENT: Exact knee/hip/ankle joint-angle bounds and sign conventions
PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REASON: CRIT-001/CRIT-002: current Plant knee/hip conventions are anatomically invalid

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REQUIREMENT: MTP/toe/arch representation or explicit reduced-foot claim
Foot-clearance numerical tolerance tied to the new foot model
PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REASON: clearance geometry depends on foot contact model

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REQUIREMENT: Support-hull geometry and active-foot margin numeric
PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REASON: HIGH-008; current margin is an AABB over inactive feet and positive in flight

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REQUIREMENT: CoP origin/frame and validity threshold binding
Signed pelvis orientation and signed trunk pitch/rate measurements

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REASON: achievable depth depends on corrected hip/knee ranges

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REQUIREMENT: Takeoff extension numeric set and takeoff-whip rate bound
PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REASON: anatomically valid extension state must exist before bounding it

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REQUIREMENT: Ballistic height residual epsilon_ball (CG-02): purely numerical (flight COM is ballistic; no model mechanism remains)
PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REASON: physics identity + numerical tolerance; candidate 1e-3 relative

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REQUIREMENT: Contact/fall collision policy including load collider
Actuator dynamics/rate-limit declaration or explicit limitation
Standing envelope numeric calibration from perturbed holds

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.DEFERRED_TO: owner OD-04 after RES-83 capability known
PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REASON: no literature threshold exists for a deterministic reduced model; must not be invented

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REQUIREMENT: E11 bounds numeric values (C_11, HY_11, M_11)
PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REASON: clinical methods do not transfer; bounds are simulation-task decisions

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REQUIREMENT: Force-threshold comparability value and sensitivity set
PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REASON: measurement convention only; candidate 10 N retained

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REQUIREMENT: Landing asymmetry tolerance and bilateral-establishment dwell
PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REASON: task tolerance, not a human-performance finding

PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REQUIREMENT: Primary performance floor H_MIN confirmation against rebuilt Plant capability
PLANT_DEPENDENT_DEFERRED.REASON: the floor is a task definition; the owner confirms it is not silently a capability target

invariants: A Plant-dependent numeric value may never be silently filled with a convenient number
Changing the Plant representation triggers COU re-adjudication per SUCCESSOR_CONTEXT_OF_USE section 10
The structural semantics frozen under PLANT_INDEPENDENT_FROZEN_NOW survive the RES-83 rebuild unless the owner re-opens the COU
